اعترضتم (form VIII)
# اِعْتَرَضْتُمْ (iʕtaraḍtum) /iʕ.ta.radˤ.tum/: second-person masculine plural past active of اِعْتَرَضَ (iʕtaraḍa)
# اُعْتُرِضْتُمْ (uʕturiḍtum) /uʕ.tu.ridˤ.tum/: second-person masculine plural past passive of اِعْتَرَضَ (iʕtaraḍa)
